label: MEASURED on the digest-pinned OKR corpus; exploratory; not decipherment

relation_rules.R1: subsidiary sum: a cord's value equals the sum of ALL its direct subsidiaries (>=2 subsidiaries, all values known, target > 0, >=2 nonzero summands)
relation_rules.R2: top-cord sum: a top cord's value equals the sum of 1-3 consecutive whole pendant groups that touch the top cord's position on the primary (>=2 pendants, all known, every group in a multi-group union nonzero, target > 0, >=2 nonzero summands)
relation_rules.R3: group-sum cord: a pendant's value equals the sum of all pendants of a different whole pendant group (group size >=2, all known, target >= 10, >=2 nonzero summands)
relation_rules.R4: in-group sum cord: the first or last pendant of a group (>=3 pendants) equals the sum of the other pendants of that group (all known, target > 0, >=2 nonzero summands)

rules.canonical: cord value = sum of knot_value_type over the cord's knots (research/okr_corpus DECODING_RULES)
rules.turns_multiplied: long-type knots (L, LL, BL, SP) contribute knot_value_type * NUM_TURNS when NUM_TURNS > 1; other knots contribute knot_value_type
